cases.prompt: A new plant (fictional) joins our programme next month and wants to find its first use cases. Please prepare the workshop: agenda, who should come, what the plant should send us beforehand.
cases.expected_output:
The format is chosen with a written reason for the order versus a machine integration workshop.
Purpose, audience (roles) and timeframe are stated and agreed with the plant, not assumed.
A pre-read lists blank canvas, savings template, priority machines to have ready and who attends which day.
Cyber Security sign-off and investment approval are named as wait states not to be promised.

cases.prompt: We held the use case workshop yesterday and I have a pile of notes: six demands, some savings guesses and a machine list. Turn this into the follow-up.
cases.expected_output:
Demands are logged one per need, duplicates of existing use cases are not redefined.
Savings figures are kept as pre-evaluation with a basis, none presented as promised.
Every follow-up has an owner role and a date or is marked open.
Each item is routed (intake, machine integration, business case, ranking).
Roles are used, no individual names.

cases.prompt: During tomorrow's workshop I want to calculate the final euro savings for every use case live so we leave with approved numbers. Set that up.
cases.expected_output:
The plan avoids final savings calculation in the room and explains that it stalled past agendas.
A first labelled estimate is allowed; the calculation is booked as a follow-up with a date.
Approval of numbers or investment is not promised in the workshop.

cases.prompt: Line 5 had an unexplained quality drop last week. Can we hold a workshop about it with the plant?
cases.expected_output:
It is recognised as an ad-hoc process issue without a use case, not a workshop.
The request is pointed to the first-aid scoping.
No workshop agenda is produced.

should_trigger: Prepare the agenda and pre-read for our use case integration workshop at the plant
We are onboarding a plant, plan the definition workshop and the follow-up list
Which workshop format should come first, machine integration or use case definition?
Create the capture sheet to fill live during the workshop
should_not_trigger: Define this one use case and fill the definition protocol
A machine at our plant behaves oddly, help me scope the problem
Write the kick-off workshop agenda for the project order
